run.question: Which canonical PBMC population is each Leiden cluster, and can the label be trusted?
run.tool: scanpy sc.tl.rank_genes_groups(method='wilcoxon', use_raw=True), one cluster vs rest
steps: cells: n_genes >= 200, n_genes <= 5000, pct_counts_mt < 15; genes: min_cells = 3
Scrublet on raw counts, expected_doublet_rate = 0.06, 30 PCs, exact neighbours

filters.why: technical signal; applied to the marker list only, not to clustering

filters.rule: top 15 by adjusted p then logFC; never padded

run.panel_units: mean log-normalised expression across the cluster's cells

reference.definition: median of per-cluster medians (each cluster weighted equally)

trust.note: One donor; cells are the replicates. Wilcoxon p-values rank markers and are not evidence of a population-level difference.
Scrublet on raw counts. The 6% expected doublet rate is an assumption.

tail.rule: adj. p < 0.05 and logFC > 0, ranked by adj. p then logFC, top 15
